execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"
CREATE TYPE "public"."RegMode" AS ENUM ('OPEN', 'INVITE', 'CLOSED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."RequestStatus" AS ENUM ('OPEN', 'FILLED', 'CLOSED', 'REJECTED')
CREATE TYPE "public"."StorageType" AS ENUM ('LOCAL', 'S3', 'DB')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserRole" AS ENUM ('USER', 'MOD', 'ADMIN', 'OWNER', 'FOUNDER')
CREATE TYPE "public"."UserStatus" AS ENUM ('ACTIVE', 'BANNED', 'DISABLED')

CREATE TABLE "public"."Announce" (
  "downloaded" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "event" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text NOT NULL,
  "lastAnnounceAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "left" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "peerId" text NOT NULL,
  "port" int4 NOT NULL,
  "torrentId" text NOT NULL,
  "uploaded" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."AnnounceRateLimit" (
  "announceCount" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "cooldownUntil" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "lastCheckedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "reason" text,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Announcement" (
  "body" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "pinned" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "visible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Bookmark" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "note" text,
  "torrentId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Category" (
  "description" text,
  "icon" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inheritSources" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4,
  "parentId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CategorySource" (
  "categoryId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isInherited" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sourceId" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Comment" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,
  "requestId" text,
  "torrentId" text,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."CommentVote" (
  "commentId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "value" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Config" (
  "allowedFingerprints" text[] DEFAULT '{}',
  "blacklistedClients" text[] DEFAULT '{}',
  "bonusPointsPerHour" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "brandingName" text,
  "defaultAnnounceInterval" int4 DEFAULT 1800 NOT NULL,
  "enableAnnounceRateCheck" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "enableCheatingClientCheck" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "enableGhostLeechingCheck" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "enableInvalidStatsCheck" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "enableIpAbuseCheck" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "enablePeerBanCheck" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "hitAndRunThreshold" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "id" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "inviteExpiryHours" int4 DEFAULT 6 NOT NULL,
  "maxInvitesPerUser" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "maxStatsJumpMultiplier" int4 DEFAULT 10 NOT NULL,
  "minAnnounceInterval" int4 DEFAULT 300 NOT NULL,
  "minRatio" float8 DEFAULT 0.5 NOT NULL,
  "ranksEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "registrationMode" "RegMode" DEFAULT 'OPEN'::"RegMode" NOT NULL,
  "requireTorrentApproval" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "requiredSeedingMinutes" int4 DEFAULT 4320 NOT NULL,
  "rssDefaultCount" int4 DEFAULT 20 NOT NULL,
  "s3AccessKeyId" text,
  "s3Bucket" text,
  "s3Region" text,
  "s3SecretAccessKey" text,
  "showHomePageStats" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "smtpFrom" text,
  "smtpHost" text,
  "smtpPass" text,
  "smtpPort" int4,
  "smtpUser" text,
  "storageType" "StorageType" DEFAULT 'DB'::"StorageType" NOT NULL,
  "whitelistedClients" text[] DEFAULT '{}',
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."DownloadToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "torrentId" text NOT NULL,
  "used" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."EmailVerificationToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "used" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."HitAndRun" (
  "downloadedAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isHitAndRun" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "lastSeededAt" timestamp(3),
  "torrentId" text NOT NULL,
  "totalSeedingTime" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Invite" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "usedAt" timestamp(3),
  "usedById" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Notification" (
  "adminId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "message" text NOT NULL,
  "read" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "relatedBanId" text,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PasswordResetToken" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "used" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."PeerBan" (
  "bannedById" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "expiresAt" timestamp(3),
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "ip" text,
  "passkey" text,
  "peerId" text,
  "reason" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Rank" (
  "color" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "minDownload" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "minRatio" float8 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "minUpload" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "order" int4 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Request" (
  "categoryId" text,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "filledById" text,
  "filledTorrentId" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" "RequestStatus" DEFAULT 'OPEN'::"RequestStatus" NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Source" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "isActive" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Torrent" (
  "categoryId" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "filePath" text NOT NULL,
  "freeleech" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "infoHash" text NOT NULL,
  "isAnonymous" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isApproved" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "isRejected" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "nfoPath" text,
  "posterFileId" text,
  "posterUrl" text,
  "rejectedAt" timestamp(3),
  "rejectedById" text,
  "rejectionReason" text,
  "size" int8 NOT NULL,
  "tags" text[] DEFAULT '{}',
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "uploaderId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."TorrentVote" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "torrentId" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  "value" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UploadedFile" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "data" bytea,
  "ext" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "mimeType" text NOT NULL,
  "size" int4 NOT NULL,
  "storageKey" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."User" (
  "allowEmailNotifications" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "avatarFileId" text,
  "avatarUrl" text,
  "bonusPoints" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "download" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "emailVerified" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "inviteCode" text,
  "passkey" text NOT NULL,
  "passwordHash" text NOT NULL,
  "preferredLanguage" text,
  "publicProfile" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "role" "UserRole" DEFAULT 'USER'::"UserRole" NOT NULL,
  "rssEnabled" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "rssToken" text,
  "status" "UserStatus" DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'::"UserStatus" NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "upload" int8 DEFAULT '0'::int8 NOT NULL,
  "username" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."UserActivity" (
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "entityId" text,
  "entityType" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "metadata" jsonb,
  "subtitle" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."WikiPage" (
  "content" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamp(3) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "createdById" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "locked" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "parentId" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamp(3) NOT NULL,
  "updatedById" text NOT NULL,
  "visible" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
